chain.label: AFM lacked emergency procedure to don masks immediately on cabin altitude warning
chain.trigger: the Learjet Model 35/36 AFM does not have an emergency procedure requiring the flight crew to don oxygen masks immediately after the cabin altitude aural warning is activated

chain.label: Airplane not equipped with automatic emergency pressurization; alternate bleed air required crew action
chain.trigger: The accident airplane was not equipped with automatic emergency pressurization; consequently, if it had experienced a loss of cabin pressurization, the pilots should have executed this procedure to initiate the alternate, emergency source of bleed air.

chain.label: Operator failed to track pressurization discrepancies and flew with unauthorized deferred maintenance
chain.trigger: Sunjet Aviation's failure to maintain pilot discrepancy records and its unauthorized operation of flights with deferred maintenance items reflects shortcomings in the company's procedures for identifying, tracking, and resolving repetitive maintenance items

chain.label: Air conditioning flow control valve closed, cutting bleed air inflow and depressurizing the cabin
chain.trigger: the condition of the flow control valve indicated that it was in its fully closed position at impact... This closed valve would have prevented bleed air from entering the cabin, thereby preventing normal pressurization.

chain.label: Crew did not don oxygen masks in time to receive supplemental oxygen
chain.trigger: Following the depressurization, the pilots did not receive supplemental oxygen in sufficient time and/or adequate concentration to avoid hypoxia and incapacitation.

caused_by.evidence: the partial pressure of oxygen in the cabin after the depressurization was insufficient for the flight crew to maintain consciousness

Because the AFM contains an abnormal procedure allowing the flight crew to troubleshoot the pressurization system before donning oxygen masks, the FAA noted that the flight crew may delay donning oxygen masks and become incapacitated.

chain.label: Both pilots incapacitated by hypoxia
chain.trigger: These events indicate that the flight crewmembers became incapacitated at some point during the 6 minutes and 20 seconds between 0927:18 and 0933:38.

caused_by.evidence: the airplane and its occupants experienced a loss of cabin pressurization some time earlier in the flight
the flight crewmembers did not receive any, or adequate, supplemental oxygen
the emergency pressurization system was not activated on the accident flight

chain.label: Unresponsive airplane climbed above assigned FL390 to 48,900 feet and flew off course for about 4 hours
chain.trigger: it deviated from its assigned course and failed to level at its assigned altitude (FL 390). There was no evidence that the flight crew attempted to intervene over the next 4 hours

caused_by.evidence: The flight crew's failure to respond to repeated ATC radio inquiries beginning at 0933:38... was the first indication of a problem

chain.label: Fuel exhausted after hours of uncommanded cruise flight
chain.trigger: Considering the length of time that the airplane had been flying, this was most likely caused by fuel exhaustion.

caused_by.evidence: the airplane continued to fly off course, ascending to 48,900 feet, and finally descended to impact

chain.label: Engine ceased operating in cruise
chain.trigger: At 1210:41 CDT, the sound of an engine winding down... can be heard on N47BA's cockpit voice recorder

caused_by.evidence: the airplane's final descent was initiated by an engine ceasing to operate... most likely caused by fuel exhaustion

chain.label: Aerodynamic stall with stickshaker and autopilot disconnect
chain.trigger: sounds similar to a stickshaker and an autopilot disconnect... engine spooldown was followed by aerodynamic stall and disengagement of the autopilot

caused_by.evidence: The CVR further indicated that engine spooldown was followed by aerodynamic stall

chain.label: Airplane departed controlled flight into a descending spiral
chain.trigger: the target is descending and he is doing multiple aileron rolls, looks like he's out of control...in a severe descent

caused_by.evidence: aerodynamic stall and disengagement of the autopilot
The military pilots observed the airplane depart controlled flight and spiral to the ground

chain.label: Airplane impacted an open field near Aberdeen, South Dakota
chain.trigger: impacting an open field... characterized by a crater that measured 42 feet, 4 inches long

caused_by.evidence: It's soon to impact the ground he is in a descending spiral.

chain.label: All six occupants killed, airplane destroyed
chain.trigger: All occupants on board the airplane (the captain, first officer, and four passengers) were killed, and the airplane was destroyed.

caused_by.evidence: impacting an open field... All occupants on board the airplane... were killed
